title: Videos folder
whyItMatters: Recordings and clips saved by the person, plus exports from editors. Names, dates and sizes show what was recorded and when, which is often more telling than the files themselves.
source: Windows known folder Videos, default path under the user profile: https://support.microsoft.com/windows
notes: Known Folder Move does not redirect Videos, so this is normally the real folder. Screen recordings from games and meeting apps are often saved here.
